resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register lists Lycoming County; the Forest Lookouts heading says Franklin County; the January 25, 1923 item names Fulton County, and both 1923 items mention McConnellsburg. The story reports the disagreement; no county change is proposed until a third source is found.

notes_for_editor: Built year (1913), use (about 1917) and fate agree across both sources. The county does not: the brief's Lycoming (matching the register, coordinates 41.40735, -76.85541 not found in any source), Franklin (Forest Lookouts heading), and Fulton (a January 1923 Harrisburg Telegraph item names Fulton County, and both items mention McConnellsburg). Get a third source (county history or topographic name records) before changing the record's county or coordinates. No photo, staffing or fire data in these sources.
